title: Typed layer operations
description: The public constructors and methods of the typed layer, grouped where several share one path through the JSON layer. Accessors (year, day_of_week, zone_id, ...) and the Outcome helpers are left out. All are queries: values are immutable, and every operation answers a new value.

entities.name: Create a date
entities.description: Makes a proleptic Gregorian date from year, month and day, or refuses it with the reason.
entities.transport: associated function CivilDate::of; also CivilYearMonth::of
entities.result: Ok(CivilDate); Err(Diagnostics) otherwise.
failures: Err, invalid (month-out-of-range): the month is not 1 to 12.
Err, invalid (day-out-of-range): the day doesn't exist in that month, such as 30 February or 29 February 2026.
Err, unsupported (implementation-limit): the year is so large that its day number leaves the i128 range.

entities.name: Create a time of day or a date-time
entities.description: Makes a CivilTime or a CivilDateTime, remembering whether a second was given.
entities.transport: associated functions CivilTime::of, of_hms, of_hms_nano and CivilDateTime::of, of_hms, of_hms_nano
entities.result: Ok with the value; Err(Diagnostics) otherwise.
failures: Err, invalid (field-out-of-range): hour beyond 23, minute beyond 59, second beyond 60 or nanosecond beyond 999,999,999.
Err, unsupported (leap-second): second 60 needs a leap-second table.
Err, invalid (month-out-of-range or day-out-of-range) for a date-time's date.
Err, unsupported (implementation-limit): a date-time whose local seconds leave the i128 range.

entities.name: Add months or years
entities.description: Month arithmetic where the day may be missing from the target month.
entities.transport: method of CivilDate (also add_years, and add_months on CivilDateTime and ZonedIntent)
entities.result: Outcome::Unique with the new value when the day exists in the target month.
failures: Outcome::None (month-end): the day doesn't exist in the target month, such as 31 January + 1 month.
Panics only if the result leaves the i128 range.

entities.name: Add months, clamping to the month's end
entities.description: The total form: a missing day becomes the last day of the target month.
entities.transport: method of CivilDate (also add_years_constrained, and CivilDateTime::add_months_constrained)
entities.result: The new value: 31 January + 1 month is 28 February 2026.
failures: Panics only if the result leaves the i128 range.

entities.name: Add a period
entities.description: Years and months, then weeks and days, then wall-clock time, under a month-end policy.
entities.transport: method of CivilDate and CivilDateTime: add(period) with MonthEnd::Reject, add_with(period, month_end)
entities.result: Outcome::Unique with the new value.
failures: Outcome::None (month-end) under MonthEnd::Reject when the day is missing after the months.
Outcome::Invalid (kind-mismatch) when a CivilDate is given a period with hours, minutes or seconds.

entities.name: Add days, weeks or wall-clock time
entities.description: Total calendar and wall-clock arithmetic, carrying into days.
entities.transport: methods add_days, add_weeks (CivilDate), add_days … add_seconds (CivilDateTime, ZonedIntent), add_months and add_years (CivilYearMonth)
entities.result: The new value; on a ZonedIntent the wall time in the same zone, with an asserted offset dropped.
failures: Panics only if the result leaves the i128 range.

entities.name: Count days between dates
entities.description: The days from one date to another, negative if the other is earlier.
entities.transport: method of CivilDate
entities.result: An i64.
failures: Panics only if the count leaves the i64 range.

entities.name: Pin a wall time to an offset
entities.description: A wall time, or an instant, at a fixed offset from UTC.
entities.transport: method of CivilDateTime and of Instant
entities.result: Ok(FixedOffsetDateTime).
failures: Err, invalid (offset-out-of-range): beyond ±18:00.
Err, unsupported (implementation-limit): Instant::at_offset for an instant with a fraction finer than a nanosecond, which civil fields can't hold.

entities.name: Name a zone for a wall time
entities.description: Turns a wall time into an intention to follow a named IANA zone's rules.
entities.transport: method of CivilDateTime
entities.result: A ZonedIntent. The zone id is not checked here: an id the rules don't know is reported when the intent is resolved (unknown-zone).

entities.name: Turn a fixed-offset date-time into an instant
entities.description: The instant a wall time at a fixed offset denotes; no rules are needed.
entities.transport: method of FixedOffsetDateTime
entities.result: An Instant.

entities.name: Resolve a zoned wall time
entities.description: The instant(s) of a wall time in a named zone, under explicit zone rules and a gap and overlap policy.
entities.transport: method of TemporalContext (resolve, resolve_with) and of ZonedIntent (resolve(&ctx), resolve_with(&ctx, policy))
entities.result: Outcome::Unique with the instant; with Gap::ShiftForward the shifted instant and an info gap note; with Overlap::Earliest or Latest one of the two.
failures: Outcome::None (gap) for a wall time that never happened, under Gap::Reject or Gap::PreserveUnresolved.
Outcome::Multiple with both instants, ascending, for a wall time that happened twice: with ambiguous under Overlap::Reject, without it under Overlap::All.
Outcome::Invalid (offset-mismatch): the asserted offset matches no candidate, including any assertion in a gap.
Outcome::Unsupported (unknown-zone): the rules have no such zone.
Outcome::Unsupported (outside-rule-window): the wall time is not at least a day inside the rules' validity window.

entities.name: See an instant in a zone
entities.description: The wall time of an instant in a named zone, with the offset in force asserted.
entities.transport: method of TemporalContext; Instant::in_zone(id, &ctx)
entities.result: Outcome::Unique with a ZonedIntent such as 2027-06-01T03:00:00-04:00[America/New_York].
failures: Outcome::Unsupported (unknown-zone): the rules have no such zone.
Outcome::Unsupported (outside-rule-window): the instant is outside the rules' validity window.
Outcome::Unsupported (implementation-limit): a fraction finer than a nanosecond.

entities.name: Order two zoned wall times
entities.description: Resolves both strictly, then compares every pair of candidates.
entities.transport: method of TemporalContext
entities.result: Outcome::Unique(Ordering) when every candidate pair agrees.
failures: Outcome::Multiple with the possible orders, ascending, when the order depends on which side of an overlap is meant; the ambiguous notes are kept.
Outcome::None or Outcome::Unsupported, with the resolution's diagnostics, when either value can't be resolved (gap, unknown-zone, outside-rule-window).
Outcome::Invalid (offset-mismatch) when an asserted offset contradicts the rules.

entities.name: Add to an instant, or measure between two
entities.description: Exact POSIX arithmetic on instants.
entities.transport: methods of Instant: add(PosixSeconds), until(other), add_elapsed(ElapsedSeconds)
entities.result: add: the Instant exactly that many POSIX seconds later; until: the exact PosixSeconds between them.
failures: add_elapsed: Outcome::Unsupported (needs-leap-seconds), always: SI seconds on a POSIX timeline need a leap-second table.
add and until panic only if the result leaves the i128 range.

entities.name: Create an instant
entities.description: An instant from Unix seconds, nanoseconds or a clock reading the caller made.
entities.transport: associated functions of Instant
entities.result: An Instant; nanoseconds of 10^9 or more carry into seconds.

entities.name: Create an amount
entities.description: A calendar Period, or an exact number of POSIX or SI seconds.
entities.transport: const fns Period::of, years … seconds; PosixSeconds::of, of_ratio; ElapsedSeconds::of, of_ratio
entities.result: The amount; a ratio is reduced.
failures: of_ratio: Err, invalid (field-out-of-range) for a zero denominator.

entities.name: Create an interval
entities.description: A range of dates or instants with included, excluded, unbounded or unknown ends.
entities.transport: associated functions Interval::of, half_open, closed
entities.result: Ok(Interval<T>).
failures: Err, invalid (reversed-interval): the end is before the start.
Err, unsupported (unsupported-form): neither end is a point, so nothing fixes the domain.

entities.name: Ask whether a range holds a point or meets another
entities.description: Three-valued answers, where an unknown end can leave the question open.
entities.transport: methods of Interval<T>: contains(&point), overlaps(&other)
entities.result: Truth::Definitely, Truth::Possibly or Truth::Impossible.

entities.name: Parse text
entities.description: Reads the text form into a typed value.
entities.transport: exported function utv::parse; T::parse(text) and FromStr ("2026-11-05".parse::<CivilDate>()) on every value type
entities.result: Outcome::Unique with the value (utv::parse: the Value variant the text describes); FromStr gives Ok or OutcomeError.
failures: Every outcome of the JSON layer's parse_text: invalid (syntax, a field's range code, reversed-interval, kind-mismatch) or unsupported (unsupported-form, unsupported-annotation, leap-second, end-of-day, implementation-limit).
Outcome::Invalid (kind-mismatch): T::parse of text that is another type.

entities.name: Read UTV JSON
entities.description: Reads a UTV JSON value into a typed value.
entities.transport: T::from_json(&json) on every value type, and Value::from_json
entities.result: Outcome::Unique with the value, operation convert.
failures: Outcome::Invalid (kind-mismatch): another kind or form than the type holds.
Outcome::Unsupported (unsupported-operand): a valid UTV value no typed type holds, such as a zoned date, a resolutionPolicy, extra properties, an interval of date-times or a recurrence.
Outcome::Invalid (malformed-value, then the validator's envelope.* or structural.schema codes): JSON of the wrong shape.
The JSON layer's own refusals: day-out-of-range, unsupported-calendar, leap-second, implementation-limit and the rest.
